Perfect — thanks Jordan, and welcome Samir.

Confirmed: Tue, Nov 24 08:30–09:00 CST / 09:30–10:00 EST. Calendar invite sent (please accept).

Quick answers for Samir so your team can triage ahead of the call:
- ECS/ECR: Redwood integrates via a simple sidecar or through our private deployment option — most customers start with hosted API and move to Dedicated/Private for strict network controls.
- GPU sizing: for production LLM workloads we typically recommend starting with 1xA10 or 1xA100 equivalent for low-concurrency pilot; we can model throughput on the call with your expected QPS.
- KMS/HSM: we support AWS KMS out-of-the-box; HSM integrations are available for Private deployments (we can share the security brief).

Attached again: redwood-demo-deck.pdf and the pre-demo checklist. If there’s anything specific you want showcased, reply here and we’ll tailor the demo.
